blocks.prompt: 2. If \(6, 11, 16\) are three A.Ms. between \(a\) and \(b\), find \(a\) and \(b\).
blocks.explanation:
"\(a\) aur \(b\) ke darmiyan teen A.M.s" ka matlab hai ke yeh paanch numbers \(a, 6, 11, 16, b\) tarteeb se ek A.P. banate hain: \(a\) pehla term aur \(b\) aakhri.
Teen beech wale terms humein maloom hain, un se common difference \(d\) mil jayega.
Plan: \(d\) nikalo, phir 6 se ek qadam peeche \(a\) aur 16 se ek qadam aage \(b\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(6, 11, 16\) teen A.M.s hain \(a\) aur \(b\) ke darmiyan
Humein find karna hai: \(a\) aur \(b\).
Tareeqa: A.P. \(a, 6, 11, 16, b\) hai. \(d\) nikal kar \(a = 6 - d\) aur \(b = 16 + d\). A.P. mein har term pichle term plus \(d\) hota hai, is liye peeche jane ke liye \(d\) minus karte hain.

Common difference nikalein
\[d = 11 - 6 = 5\]
\[16 - 11 = 5\]
Kyun: A.P. mein har do lagataar terms ka farq \(d\) hota hai. \(11 - 6\) aur \(16 - 11\) dono 5 hain, is liye \(d = 5\) pakka hai.

\(a\) aur \(b\) nikalein
\[a = 6 - 5 = 1\]
\[b = 16 + 5 = 21\]
Kyun: \(a\) se ek \(d\) jama karne par 6 banta hai, is liye \(a = 6 - 5\). Aur 16 mein ek \(d\) jama karne par \(b\) banta hai.
Dhyan dein: \(a\) aur \(b\) A.M.s nahi, A.P. ke kinare (pehla aur aakhri term) hain.

Tasdeeq
\[1,\ 6,\ 11,\ 16,\ 21\]
\[\text{gaps} = 5 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Poori list 1, 6, 11, 16, 21 mein har farq 5 hai, matlab yeh A.P. hai aur 6, 11, 16 waqai 1 aur 21 ke darmiyan teen A.M.s hain.
